about: Turns labelled with the view Alex Tran's rules give them (A conversation → Chat; B documents → Content in the background; C something to look at → Artifacts; D structure → the Logic Map). Graded offline, with no model, against the runtime's own reader (lib/runtime/orchestrate.ts routeTurn) by evals/logos5/run.mjs. A small set, written alongside the rules — a regression check and a statement of intent, not an independent benchmark.
